_om: Forsidens historie, akt 2. Akt 1 er den ferdige scenen «hero» i scener.json: en blank, umerket blokk der kjerneprøven skyves ut og blottlegger et konstruert indre. Denne fila fortsetter DEN historien med samme objekt, samme kamera og samme lys – ikke platestabelen, som er et annet objekt. Poenget er at seksjon seks bare gir mening fordi du har sett seksjon tre.
_bevar: Keep exactly identical: camera position, perspective, framing, lighting direction and intensity, rim light, the near-black #0b0d10 background, and the size, proportions, position, material and surface finish of the main block. The block itself never moves, rotates or changes shape. Its outer faces stay plain, blank and unmarked. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere.
_bevegelse: Locked-off static camera; the camera does not move, zoom, pan or reframe. Silent product shot. Start exactly on the first frame and end exactly on the last frame. Hold still for the first and last half second; in between, one single continuous movement at constant speed. The objects are rigid and keep their exact shape, size, thickness and material in every frame and never bend, melt, morph or rotate. The same number of objects is visible in every frame. Lighting, reflections and the background stay constant. Avoid: camera movement, camera shake, zoom, pan, cut, scene change, lens switch, morphing, melting, warping, extra objects, missing objects, text, letters, logos, watermark, flicker, particles, lens flare, motion blur.

scener._hvorfor: Akt 2. Akt 1 endte med at kjerneprøven er trukket ut og hulrommet står åpent. Her settes innholdet inn igjen, ett lag om gangen, mens den limegrønne linjen vokser. Det er «Fire steg, kjente tider» gjort fysisk, og det er samme blokk, samme kamera og samme lys som akt 1 – derfor leses de to som én historie og ikke som to bilder.
scener.basisPrompt: A single solid rectangular block of matte bead-blasted anodised aluminium resting on the invisible floor, filling the right 60 percent of the frame. Its outer faces are completely plain, blank and featureless, with fine 45-degree chamfers along every edge. Near the right end of the front face, a precise rectangular cavity is cut into the block, open and empty, its inner walls showing bare machined aluminium. The cavity is exactly large enough to hold four thin flat plates stacked horizontally. Nothing protrudes from the block.
scener.bevar: Keep exactly identical: camera position, perspective, framing, lighting direction and intensity, rim light, the near-black #0b0d10 background, and the size, proportions, position, material and surface finish of the main block and of its rectangular cavity. The block itself never moves, rotates or changes shape. Its outer faces stay plain, blank and unmarked. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere.
scener.start: Change only the four plates: exactly FOUR thin flat rectangular plates of the same matte aluminium float in a row in the open air to the LEFT of the block, evenly spaced, all perfectly level and parallel, each aligned with the open cavity and ready to slide in. The cavity in the block is completely empty. No green light anywhere in the frame.
scener.slutt: Change only the four plates: the same FOUR thin flat plates are now fully seated inside the rectangular cavity, stacked horizontally one above the other with equal hair-thin gaps, their front edges flush with the block's front face. The air to the left of the block is now completely empty. Exactly one hair-thin lime green #c8f24a line runs horizontally along the front edge of the stacked plates inside the cavity, covering less than three percent of the image. Nothing else is green.
scener.bevegelse: The four thin plates glide straight sideways into the open cavity in the block, one after another from left to right, each staying perfectly level and parallel, until all four are seated flush inside. The block stays completely still. As each plate seats, the hair-thin lime green line along the front edge of the stack grows a little longer, reaching its full length as the fourth plate arrives.
